domains.name: Application setup with the Okta Integration Network

weights_note: Okta's study guide gives each hands-on use case a percentage: 26 / 10 / 8 / 38 / 12 / 6 (Okta Certified Professional Performance Exam Study Guide, checked 2026-11-05). The objective split inside each use case is this course's own, following the listed tasks.

objectives.1.3: Administrator roles, custom roles and resource sets
objectives.2.1: SSO app integrations from the OIN (SAML, OIDC, SWA)
objectives.5.2: App access and group assignment troubleshooting
objectives.6.2: Okta help, status and support resources

exam_questions_note: The real exam is six hands-on use cases in 150 minutes, graded pass or fail; Okta does not publish a passing score. This course's practice exam is 60 questions in 90 minutes, and 70 % is a PROJECTED readiness target, not Okta's mark.

exam_target.name: Okta Certified Professional
exam_target.note: No retirement date is announced. Performance exam on Okta Identity Engine: 6 hands-on use cases, 150 minutes, USD 250 (USD 100 per retake), open book (Okta Help Center), Okta Verify required, proctored online by ProctorU by Meazure Learning; pass or fail only. The older Hands-On Configuration exam was discontinued June 1, 2024.

pass_label: Okta grades pass or fail; this course uses 70 % as a readiness target
